title: Relay Round 6 portrait failure and art-method correction
summary: Founder quality feedback: the Relay Round 6 portrait resembles crude MS Paint drawing and is not a polished or sufficiently faithful Echo Frame design. Basic programmatic circles, polygons, flat fills, and added surface speckles are not a substitute for strong character-design fundamentals. Corrective workflow: study canonical Relay reference; establish an appealing, asymmetrical perspective-correct head and strong silhouette; build helmet/CRT display/hood and armor in meaningful layered planes; place and revise pixel clusters deliberately; verify visual fidelity at native resolution on light and dark backgrounds; only after the still image succeeds add wear, moss, corruption, or animation. Preserve all existing animation, overgrowth, silhouette and glitch training. Treat this pass as an unsuccessful quality-gate attempt and retain critique rather than celebrating minor metrics.
source: Founder direct visual critique of Relay portrait Round 6, Nov 2026
